lines.en: I glide forward on the water's swell.
My staff sinks through the water.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞窟的水道游过来。
lines.en: I swim along the cave channel.

lines.zh: 我一步一步上岸，袍子滴水。
lines.en: I climb ashore step by step, robe dripping.
I walk round the edge of the deep pool.
I shift toward your side.
I push myself along in the water, lightly.

lines.zh: 我经过一块礁石，摸了摸。
lines.en: I pass a reef stone and touch it.
I go around your feet.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩壁走，水没到腰。
lines.en: I walk the rock wall, water to my waist.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边念着水声。
lines.en: I chant with the sound of the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，水面起了圈。
lines.en: I come closer, and rings spread on the surface.

lines.zh: 我从水里浮起半个身子。
lines.en: I lift half my body from the water.
I drag my robe toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的杖尖在水面点了一下。
lines.en: My staff tip touches the surface once.
I turn slowly to a new heading.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，杖立在身边。
lines.en: I soak in the water, staff upright beside me.
I draw a circle on the water.
I chant a very low strain.
My robe spreads out in the water.
I wait for the surface to settle itself.
I turn the staff half a turn.
My fingers move underwater.
I listen to water dripping from the roof.

lines.zh: 我把夜视药水轻轻晃了晃。
lines.en: I swirl the potion of night vision.
I tip the water from my palm back.
I am patient, and so is the water.

lines.zh: 我数着洞顶落下的水滴。
lines.en: I count the drops falling from the cave roof.
I watch for bubbles to rise.
I plant the staff in the sand.

lines.zh: 这片水归我，你踩进来了。
lines.en: These waters are mine, and you waded in.
I know the smell of land-dwellers.

lines.zh: 你身上的护甲在水里很重。
lines.en: Your armour is heavy in water.
I raise my staff and the water answers.
You had best not sink.
I can trade with you.

lines.zh: 你咳嗽了，这里的水不给你呼吸。
lines.en: You coughed; this water will not let you breathe.
I look at you as at a fish.
You back off, and I let the water fall back.

lines.zh: 我的杖能让你在水下喘气。
lines.en: My staff can let you breathe below.
I sink a little, then steady.

lines.zh: 我的袍子破了，水在往里灌。
lines.en: My robe is torn and water pours in.
I retreat into the water to recover.
I hold my shoulder without a sound.
The light on my staff dims.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里透出一声闷响。
lines.en: A muffled note escapes my throat.
The water took part of it.

lines.zh: 我浮正身子，袍子还在滴水。
lines.en: I right myself, robe still dripping.
You fight better than I expected.
I pull back and raise the staff again.
The bottle in your hand; give it to me.
I know that potion.

lines.zh: 搁在那块湿石头上就好。
lines.en: Leave it on that wet stone.
I have better; will you trade?
Water-breathing things, I have them.

lines.zh: 你身上的光，会招来别的。
lines.en: Your light will draw others.

lines.zh: 你往水边走一步，我就过来。
lines.en: One step toward the water and I come.

lines.zh: 你把宝石拿出来我看看。
lines.en: Bring out the gem and let me see.
That staff is of no use to me.
Do you want night vision? We can talk.

lines.zh: 泡牢晃了晃，我没沉下去。
lines.en: My bubble sways; I do not sink.

lines.zh: 我被撞得沉下去，又浮上来。
lines.en: Knocked under, I bob back up.
I brace on my staff and steady myself.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，袍子缠住你的手。
lines.en: You hit me and my robe tangles on your hand.
I step back half a pace and the water parts.
We collide and sand swirls from the bottom.
I reach out to steady you, and my hand is cold.

lines.zh: 深潜者法师，泡牢托着我。
lines.en: The deep one mage floats on a bubble prison.
After we part, I float where I am.
You step on me and I sink a little.
There are many deep ones in the water.
I care more for the incantations.
You ask at an awkward time.
My kind are in the depths.
I sink slowly back to the bottom.
That is no concern of yours.
I am content beneath the water.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇头，水面起了纹。
lines.en: I shake my head and the surface ripples.
There are no such words in the water.
You should get back on land.
I flick it up with my staff.
I hold it and water runs off.
I will take this bottle.

lines.zh: 我把它收进湿透的袍子。
lines.en: I tuck it into my soaked robe.
I know this one; it comes from the sea.
I pick it up; very light.

lines.zh: 我把它放进水下的石缝。
lines.en: I put it in a crack below the water.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西都是我的。
lines.en: What falls in the water is mine.
I fumble and it sinks once.
This will trade for a good deal.

lines.zh: 我把你选作这一发目标。
lines.en: I pick you for this cast.
You stand at the edge of my water.
I raise my staff and the surface ripples.
This target is in the water; good.
I swing my staff tip toward you.
Your position has fallen into the water.
I murmur the water spell.
I can strike without coming close.

lines.zh: 水弹已经在我掌心打转。
lines.en: A water bolt spins in my palm.

lines.zh: 你站的那块石头，是我的。
lines.en: That stone you stand on is mine.

lines.zh: 我一直泡在水里看着你。
lines.en: I stay in the water and watch you.
You head for the bank, and I do not follow.

lines.zh: 你退回水里，我就在这儿。
lines.en: You step back into the water, and I am right here.

lines.zh: 我杖尖的水珠一滴滴落向你。
lines.en: Drops fall from my staff tip toward you.
You hear water; that is me.
I circle slowly behind you.
You step back and the water rises an inch.
A bubble holds me up; I never land.
There are droplets on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我听着你的气息，一次也没漏。
lines.en: I follow your breath and miss none.

lines.zh: 我一杖点过去，水跟着来。
lines.en: I thrust the staff and the water comes with it.
A water bolt strikes your chest.
I release a fan of waves.
That washes you back.

lines.zh: 我转身横扫，水成了刀刃。
lines.en: I spin and sweep, and water turns to a blade.

lines.zh: 你被泡牢笼住，浮了起来。
lines.en: A bubble trap takes you and you float.
I grip your arm, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你拿武器的手。
lines.en: That one caught your weapon hand.
You retreat, and the surface still trembles.
I strike your knee with the staff.
Rings spread across the surface.

lines.zh: 气泡先浮上来，然后是我。
lines.en: Bubbles rise first, then me.
You see the tip of a staff first.
The stones by the water grow wet.
I surface in the cave channel.
My hem breaks the surface first.
The water suddenly goes still.

lines.zh: 我站在浅水里，等你发现。
lines.en: I stand in the shallows, waiting to be noticed.
I land and water splashes onto the bank.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，水从脸上流下。
lines.en: I raise my head, water running off my face.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我往后缩。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and I shrink back.

lines.zh: 我从岸上跌落，砸进水里。
lines.en: I fall from the bank and crash into the water.

lines.zh: 水也会淹我，我挣扎着往上。
lines.en: Even I can drown; I struggle upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水都掀起来，我被抛出去。
lines.en: The blast throws up the water and me with it.
The arrow comes and the water turns it aside.

lines.zh: 对方的法术压住我的杖光。
lines.en: Their magic smothers my staff's light.

lines.zh: 这里没有能吃的东西，我虚弱了。
lines.en: There is nothing to eat here, and I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水过来，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning comes through the water and I go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，水也留不住我。
lines.en: The void pulls and even the water cannot keep me.
